assertions: The response routes the enrichment task to the disease-structure sub-skill of gget.
The response sets ensembl=True with a list of versioned Ensembl IDs and explains the version-at-first-dot strip plus Ensembl info lookup to symbols, per enrichr.md.
The response uses database="KEGG_2021_Human" (or the pathway shortcut) with background_list and ensembl_bkg=True for an explicit experimental background.

The response lists the exact returned Enrichr DataFrame columns rank, path_name, p_val, z_score, combined_score, overlapping_genes, adj_p_val, database and selects top-N locally because there is no limit parameter.
The response notes unknown Ensembl IDs are warned and skipped, and that pykegg is needed only for kegg_out pathway rendering.
The response does not direct the user to the original gget source repository checkout.
